description: In the term model of a complete consistent set \(S\), every closed term \(t\) has value \([t]\), with each added constant interpreted by its own class.
signature:

  (hS : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Consistent S)
  (hC : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.Complete S) (t : L.Term ℕ) :
  FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinCompleteness.nameValue S hS hC) t = ⟦t⟧
